# Test fixtures

Files that the integration tests upload.

- `blue-marble.jpg` is 960 pixels wide and 261 KB, under the 5 MB upload limit.
- `blue-marble-large.jpg` is the full-size photo, at 6.2 MB, over the limit.

Both are "The Blue Marble", taken by the Apollo 17 crew on 7 December 1972. The
photo is by NASA and is in the public domain. Source:
<https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Earth_seen_from_Apollo_17.jpg>
